excludeCategories.description: Skip businesses whose category contains any of these words, for example ["hotel", "casino"].
excludeCategories.title: Exclude categories

hasPhone.description: Only keep businesses that publish a phone number on their Google Maps listing.
hasPhone.title: Must have a phone number

hasWebsite.description: Only keep businesses that publish a website on their Google Maps listing.
hasWebsite.title: Must have a website

includeClosed.description: When off, businesses Google marks as permanently closed are skipped.
includeClosed.title: Include permanently closed businesses

includeDetails.description: Read the place panel for Plus Code, price range, hotel and fuel details, attributes, photo count and rating histogram. Adds one request per place; the basic listing fields and weekly hours are always included.
includeDetails.title: Include place details

language.description: Language for Google Maps names, categories, addresses and hours.
language.title: Language

location.description: Optional location appended to each search term, for example 'Austin, TX'. Leave blank when the location is already in the query.
location.title: Location (optional)

locations.description: Several locations in one run, for example ["New York, NY", "Austin, TX"]. Each term is searched in each location.
locations.title: Locations (batch)

maxRating.description: Only keep businesses rated at or below this value.
maxRating.title: Maximum rating

maxResults.description: Places to collect per search in search mode, or in total in the direct modes. Google returns a ranked window of roughly 160-230 places for a typical query; split broad searches by neighborhood or category for wider coverage.
maxResults.title: Max Results

maxReviews.description: Only keep businesses with at most this many reviews.
maxReviews.title: Maximum review count

minRating.description: Only keep businesses rated at or above this value. Businesses with no published rating are skipped.
minRating.title: Minimum rating

minReviews.description: Only keep businesses with at least this many reviews.
minReviews.title: Minimum review count

mode.description: Search mode uses a text query; placeUrls mode reads specific Maps URLs; placeIds mode resolves canonical ChIJ Place IDs.
mode.title: Mode

nameFilter.description: Only keep businesses whose name contains this text, for example "pizza".
nameFilter.title: Business name contains

openNow.description: Only keep businesses Google currently shows as open.
openNow.title: Open now only

placeIds.description: Canonical Google Place IDs beginning with ChIJ. Used in placeUrls and placeIds modes; the two direct modes accept a mixed batch.
placeIds.title: Google Place IDs

placeUrls.description: Google Maps place URLs to read directly. Used in placeUrls and placeIds modes; the two direct modes accept a mixed batch.
placeUrls.title: Place URLs

searchQuery.description: What to search for on Google Maps. Include a location for best results, for example 'coffee shops in New York'. Used when mode is search.
searchQuery.title: Search Query

searchTerms.description: Several search terms in one run, for example ["coffee shops", "dentists"]. Each term is searched in every location.
searchTerms.title: Search terms (batch)
